subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp unmentioned automatic group runs use this narrow no-typing mitigation, or should the project wait for a visible-delivery/send-start typing boundary?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes typing feedback for proactive visible unmentioned group replies, and tests cannot decide that WhatsApp UX contract for maintainers.

options.title: Rebase Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and keep the no-typing tradeoff explicit for unmentioned non-command WhatsApp group runs.

options.title: Prefer Visible-Delivery Boundary
options.body: Pause this branch and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 the structural path after its compatibility and API concerns are resolved.

options.title: Keep Current Typing Semantics
options.body: Reject the broader suppression and preserve typing indicators for automatic unmentioned visible replies until a send-start design lands.

recommendation.title: Rebase Narrow Mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and keep the no-typing tradeoff explicit for unmentioned non-command WhatsApp group runs.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and verified the prior narrowed WhatsApp typing mitigation, so he is the best routed owner for accepting or rejecting this follow-up tradeoff.
